user.title: Powerchainger setup
user.description:
Thank you for helping us with data collection. Select the devices you want to share with us below, and toggle "send data" to on.

Assigned username: {username}

What we collect: the name of the sensor and its electricity usage. No other information is sent (not your name, location, or any other sensitive data). Please note: we can only use your data if you collect at least 6 weeks of data for us.

Please get into contact with us at: marios@powerchainger.nl

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Powerchainger instance is supported.
